BiblicalUsage: Filth is what is swept away, and Isaiah says the dead bodies of the people will be as filth in the streets. The word appears once, in the judgment on a people who have refused God. The picture is of refuse, thrown out and left.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the filth in Isaiah is what sin makes of a people, and the judgment is that God leaves them to it.
